authority: User instruction relayed by control on2026-11-04: relax the news restriction and assign zero when news or movements are confirmed absent. Unknown data must not be converted to zero.
prior_results_known: The original diagnostic v3 and provider TR4 results were reviewed before this follow-up was requested. This is a transparently post-baseline specification extension, frozen before its own coefficients, not an ex ante original hypothesis test.

parent_spec.inheritance: All quantity/price/action, universe/origin, return, factor, alpha and inference rules remain unchanged unless explicitly overridden below. This new file has priority only for news-score eligibility/zero treatment and the48-cell model grid.

changes_only: Remove the50% news-trade-coverage gate; continue to report coverage and missingness.
Remove the two-contributing-company gate. One company is sufficient for a positive-denominator ratio; zero contributing companies can qualify only through an explicitly confirmed zero case.
Construct current and previous-news scores independently, not on a paired common E set.
Assign explicit zeros to confirmed no-candidate/no-relevant-news, no measurable movement and observed zero-signal-denominator cases under the evidence rules below.

Estimate current-only on its own eligible sample, without requiring a previous-news score. Estimate current-plus-lagnews where both independently constructed scores are known, including confirmed zero lagnews.

notation.i: Union-held corporate security, respecting inherited non-news exclusions.
notation.t: Selected actual holdings interval ending at d1 and beginning at d0.
notation.B_Q: Unchanged RUB-valued estimated quantity change in CURRENT interval t: continuing/exit=(Q1_adjusted-Q0)*P0; confirmed entry=Q1*P1. Missing Q/P, unconfirmed endpoint absence or unresolved identity/action stays unknown.
notation.Net_j: Existing frozen eligible company sentiment (positive count-negative count)/relevant classified count in exact window j; a separate news-absence status may imply zero contribution but is not an LLM-neutral classification.
notation.E_j: Independent set of usable current-interval security contributions with measurable B_Q, valid identity/non-news eligibility and known sentiment or confirmed absence in window j.
notation.epsilon_j: 1e-12*max(1,sum over E_j of abs(B_Q)); unchanged numerical-zero convention.
notation.NTS_j: Relaxed score: A_j/D_j for D_j>epsilon_j; otherwise explicit0 only under a justified zero status; otherwise NA.

source_contract.news_universe_proof: Use the frozen selected company/mapping registry and its source coverage, not mere presence/absence in the successful-label table. Preserve the title-name/no-GAZ mapping selection. Outside that universe is OUTSIDE_NEWS_UNIVERSE, never confirmed no news.
source_contract.missing_window_rule: A missing joined row is unknown. If necessary, reconstruct only missing exact company windows from already frozen events and the unchanged real-report calendar; save provenance. No news download, live-Gemma refresh, new LLM call or alternative mapping selection.
source_contract.hash_policy: Pin all reused inputs to their existing sealed manifests, record hashes and exact window/member IDs before regressions. No source overwrites.

news_status_rules.condition: n_candidates>0; n_valid=n_candidates; n_relevant>0; no errors/unattempted or unresolved undated candidates; finite existing Net_j.
news_status_rules.action: Use the existing Net_j unchanged; Net_j=0 is valid observed neutral/balanced sentiment.

news_status_rules.condition: An explicit exact-window record or verified frozen-event reconstruction has n_candidates=0; company is inside the frozen news universe; source/window coverage is known; no unresolved undated company candidates.
news_status_rules.action: Zero news contribution with ZERO_NO_CANDIDATES_IN_FROZEN_CORPUS. This means no candidates under this corpus/mapping, not no news anywhere. strict_complete may be false solely because the old builder required n_candidates>0.

news_status_rules.condition: n_candidates>0; n_valid=n_candidates; n_relevant=0; all candidates were validly classified irrelevant; no errors/unattempted or unresolved undated candidates.
news_status_rules.action: Zero news contribution with ZERO_ALL_CANDIDATES_IRRELEVANT; do not label these articles neutral.

news_status_rules.condition: Incomplete classification, failed/unattempted calls, ambiguous dates or missing mapping.
news_status_rules.action: Unknown news contribution (NA); do not use the observed-only sentiment or absence of successful labels to assign0.

news_status_rules.condition: No verified preceding actual report interval or unresolved chain.
news_status_rules.action: lagnews=NA, not0. This does not invalidate a known current score.

news_status_rules.condition: No explicit status/window record, unknown company mapping, outside frozen news universe or unavailable coverage.
news_status_rules.action: NA with precise reason, never synthetic no-news status.

score_construction.independence: Do not reuse NTS_common_E or the old eligible_for_score column as an aggregate gate: those encode both news windows. Recover unchanged pre-news quantity/action/identity eligibility and apply the above rules separately for current and lagnews.
score_construction.inherited_selection: Retain inherited non-news exclusions, including previously documented P99/quantity/action exclusions; no new percentile or trimming. A position absent solely because the prior pipeline required observed news may be restored from the already saved union-held positions once its news status is explicitly established. Save restoration reasons; being outside the inherited target is not itself evidence of absent news. Do not reinstate known non-news exclusions.
score_construction.positive_denominator: For D_j>epsilon_j use A_j/D_j in[-1,1]. Partial observed coverage is allowed without a numerical coverage threshold; unknown contributions are excluded, not set0, and must remain visible in missing/coverage counts. Label partial-subportfolio scores accordingly.
score_construction.zero_denominator: For D_j<=epsilon_j a zero requires affirmative observed support. If unresolved in-scope contributions could produce nonzero B_Q*Net_j, retain NA_INCOMPLETE_ZERO_EVIDENCE instead. An empty/all-NA sum cannot establish zero. Positions genuinely outside the news universe are reported separately and cannot alone establish a score.
score_construction.zero_no_movement: A finite measured B_Q=0 makes that contribution0 without imputing its unknown sentiment. Fund-level ZERO_NO_MEASURED_MOVEMENT requires nonempty usable scope and all relevant movements established as zero, not all missing prices/quantities. Apply the inherited numerical-zero tolerance and record near-zero versus exact-zero evidence.
score_construction.zero_no_news: ZERO_CONFIRMED_NEWS_ABSENCE requires explicit accepted absence statuses for the in-scope positions and adequate quantity evidence. Missing Q/P is not repaired by saying no news. Mixed unknown in-scope news cannot be silently turned into fund-level no-news0.
score_construction.zero_observed_signal: If measured eligible contributions have zero D_j because observed Net_j values are0 (including balanced positive/negative news), use ZERO_OBSERVED_SIGNAL_DENOMINATOR, provided no unresolved in-scope contribution prevents establishing this zero.
score_construction.offsetting_alignment: If D_j>epsilon_j but A_j=0 through offsetting products, score0 has status OBSERVED_OFFSETTING_ALIGNMENT, distinct from all absence/neutrality cases.
score_construction.nonapplicable_empty_scope: If no eligible corporate/news-universe exposure can be established, use NA_NO_APPLICABLE_SCOPE, not an invented no-trade or no-news0.
score_construction.zero_status_priority: Keep separate boolean evidence flags for all applicable mechanisms. For a single display label prioritize no measured movement, confirmed news absence, observed zero-signal denominator, then offsetting alignment. Do not discard the underlying flags.
score_construction.lag_interpretation: lagnews remains CURRENT quantity changes aligned with PREVIOUS-interval news; not previous trading and not a lag of the relaxed current score.

diagnostic.basis: UNIT_VALUE_KNOWN_ADJUSTMENTS; factor-adjusted unit-value growth, not verified TR

provider_TR4.basis: Only228 approved printed provider-convention monthly returns,4 funds,2022-01..2026-09; no NAV promotion

outcomes_unchanged.alpha: Reuse PRIMARY60/36 alpha with last12>=9, original factors/RF, conditioning, actual-origin and future-anchor gates, complete future months, h1/2/3 and past_alpha control. No shorter-history, credit or alternative-return branch is added.
outcomes_unchanged.origin_set: Reuse the prior selected genuine latest-closing report origins and dated fund-universe eligibility before news-score gates; do not select earlier same-month origins to fill failures.

variants.sample: Own eligible current-score sample; do not require lagnews or a predecessor-news score.
Both independent scores observed or explicitly confirmed zero; unknown lag/current remains excluded.

model_grid.estimator: Unweighted fund-FE OLS; only past_alpha control; no time FE; one-way fund CR1; t(G-1) and95%CI; retain native residual-df output separately.
model_grid.minimum_inference: N>=30 after singleton removal, G>=2, identified finite regressors and positive residual df. G<30 is fragile/no stars. Two-target joint Wald requires G>=3 and identified positive-definite rank2 target covariance; otherwise NA.
model_grid.tests: Current-only: theta_current=0. Distributed: current, lagnews, full-covariance coefficient sum and joint zero test. Sum is not a two-period cumulative treatment effect.
model_grid.no_additional_grid: No new control search, cuts, shorter history, nonoverlapping phases, credit factor, extra common-sample regressions or p-based choice in this bounded step.
model_grid.sample_comparison: Current-only and distributed use different available samples by design. Report overlap and exclusions; do not attribute coefficient differences solely to adding lagnews. Compare old/new scores and inclusion decisions on shared origins without additional regression fits.
model_grid.report_all: All48 labels, including NA and both signs; ordinary unadjusted p-values, no minimum-p headline and no new multiplicity rule.

interpretation.new_estimand: Association of future factor-adjusted performance with OBSERVED news alignment augmented by documented inactivity/absence at0. The zero group now mixes absence, no movement, balanced/neutral signals and offsetting alignment; it is not an LLM-neutral group.
interpretation.limits: This changes both score meaning and eligible sample. A difference from the earlier model cannot be attributed solely to better measurement. Partial coverage, V/P proxies, flows, unobserved intrainterval trades and generated-score/outcome uncertainty remain. Four TR funds of one manager remain a nonrepresentative, few-cluster subset.
interpretation.hypothesis: H3 remains future fund performance. No positive effect is guaranteed and a significant negative association does not identify a behavioral mechanism.

required_outputs: Frozen spec/input manifest and implementation hash before coefficients; no coefficient-informed changes.
Separate position/window status ledger including zero evidence, unknown/outside-scope cases and restored news-only exclusions; large tables stay onPC.
Fund-period scores with independent numerator/denominator, contributing companies, zero-type counts, coverage and unknown shares.
Old-to-new inclusion flow per branch/group/horizon/variant, plus primary alpha-only to known-current to known-both to inference flow.
All48 model labels, exact used-sample hashes, coefficients/full covariance/tests/native output, and explicit unestimable reasons.
Read-only implementation/interpretation review and separate numerical QA after the frozen run.
QA_acceptance: Known finite current remains eligible when lag is unknown; current-only never depends on lag.
True observed zero, confirmed absence and no movement are distinguishable from technical missingness.
All-NA sums, outside-universe companies, missing predecessor intervals and failed LLM/mapping/price cases do not become synthetic zeros.
Single-company positive-denominator scores are allowed; no50% or two-company threshold survives accidentally.
No paired-current-lag E restriction remains; existing non-news physical/identity/exclusion gates remain.
Outcomes, alpha gates and source versions are identical to the corresponding prior branch on shared origins.
preservation: New derived version only. Do not edit old H3/H1/H2 data, regressions, specs, protected bulk resources, live Gemma or RESEARCH_NOTES. Unexpected missing source-status evidence stays NA and is reported; do not broaden rules after seeing coefficients.
